messages.text: Would it be possible to move it to next Friday?

messages.text: Please make another recording. At the beginning, the translation or delivery of “Ana m efunahụ ego mgbe niile, ọ dị m ka ihe adịghị mma na egwuregwu a!” was a little poor. It is very important that you read this message correctly from the phone, while everything else must be said exactly according to the script.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Hello)

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: The revised copy is here.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Please note that once the script is translated into Igbo, its wording runs longer than 90-120secs, so the exact game actions cannot all be read within that duration.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
Open with the actor saying:
"Someone sent me a message." (The actor begins reading the message from the phone.)
"I keep losing all the time. It feels like something is wrong with the game." — Ana m efunahụ ego mgbe niile, ọ dị m ka ihe adịghị mma na egwuregwu a!
(Ana m efunahụ ego mgbe niile, ọ dị m ka ihe adịghị mma na egwuregwu a! — translation of the message.)
The actor then replies:
"Most likely, you downloaded a fake version where it’s impossible to win!
Let me demonstrate what the fake version looks like.
We’ll play this one first.
The graphics seem strange.
There, we played and lost immediately, right?
That is the fake version.
Next, let’s open the real app.
We’ll play here for a little while.
I’ve already placed my bet at €35, okay?
Notice that the graphics are different here.
Four more steps... great.
€2,480.
I personally controlled every step.
Now let’s withdraw the money.
We’ll wait a moment for the winning confirmation to appear here.
The money is already in my account.
Look, my banking app has already sent a notification.
That’s everything.
See?
The entire process took 12 minutes.
It really is that simple.
This is why many people lose their money: they play through fake apps.
Use the link below the video to download only the official app and earn money just as I do."

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Please use the script provided here as your guide, because the video opening was wrong again. Start with this wording, read it carefully, and say it exactly as written.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: It’s the introduction script that you keep changing.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: The line you sent now differs from the first line shown here.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: No, it hasn’t changed. I resent the entire script because you aren’t speaking its wording clearly.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Watch the video; I was reading from the phone.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Good morning. Could you specify exactly what you dislike and point out the lines that sounded unclear? Hello.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Yes, I’ll write out the clarification for you now. Hello)
